title: IdeaIntakeItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-idea-intake, nested inside the standard AgentOutput envelope (schemas/agent-output-schema.json). items carries META POINTS about idea-brief.md, not the full document — the complete narrative (full problem statement, full value proposition) lives ONLY in the artifact, saved to s3 (blob storage). 'summary' fields here are short distillations (<=~15 words / 90 chars) for orchestration and downstream triage; a consumer needing the full text retrieves the artifact from its storage.location. Structured/classificatory fields (ids, status, confidence, citation-equivalents) are NOT prose duplication and are kept in full — those ARE the meta points. No citation objects — this agent grounds against the raw input text, not a knowledge base, so each item carries traced_to (the input excerpt supporting it) instead of a KB citation.

summary.description: Short distillation (~15 words), NOT the full sentence(s) written into idea-brief.md — see the artifact for the complete text

reasoning.description: Why this was extracted/synthesized this way

traced_to.description: The specific input excerpt this is grounded in

summary.description: Short distillation — full description is in the artifact's Target Users section

metric.description: Metric names are already short — not narrative prose, kept in full

status.description: stated = explicit in input; suggested = inferred, must read 'suggested — pending stakeholder validation' downstream

question.description: Already a short, self-contained question — not narrative prose, kept in full
